name: Competitor Watch
summary: Did the competitor pricing page change since the last check?
description: Fetches one public pricing page a day, hashes it, and reports whether it changed since the previous read, with the changed lines and the fetch time. The only plugin in the registry that opens a network connection; it reads no local files.
highlights: One public pricing page, checked daily
Change flag plus the lines that changed
The only network plugin; needs admin approval

network.userPrompt: Allow this plugin to read https://example.com/pricing once a day to detect pricing changes?
